name: beep-me
description: Bring Beep Me answers back to Codex, and send Codex approval requests to your phone.

interface.shortDescription: Answers from your phone come back to Codex
interface.longDescription: When Codex asks you something with the Beep Me notify tool, the plugin waits for your answer and continues the session with it. Turn on BEEPME_PROMPTS to approve Codex commands from your phone.
